stories.headline: Judge rules Pentagon's Anthropic ban unlawful
stories.summary: A federal judge ruled the Pentagon unlawfully retaliated against Anthropic and denied it due process when designating the AI company a supply-chain risk. Further litigation or an appeal remains possible.

stories.headline: Tencent releases open-source Hy4 AI preview
stories.summary: Tencent released Hy4, a preview open-source mixture-of-experts model for coding, research and financial analysis. Tencent warns the early release may over-verify and take too long on complex prompts.

stories.headline: Nepal flood toll rises as rescues continue
stories.summary: Nepal's disaster authority reported 538 deaths and 977 missing after catastrophic flash floods; 3,742 people had been rescued. Figures remain fluid, and an overflowing barrier lake raises further-flood risk.

stories.headline: Russia sends new drone waves toward Kyiv
stories.summary: Russian drone waves struck Kyiv and surrounding areas for a second day, killing at least one person and damaging homes and logistics sites, Ukrainian officials said. The damage assessment is continuing.

stories.headline: Diplomacy focuses on reopening Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Qatar pressed Iran to restore freedom of navigation; Tehran said it would draft conditions for normal traffic. U.S. and Iranian accounts differ on how open the strait is, while ship traffic remains far below normal.
